history.p: The Danish sculptor Bertel Thorvaldsen died in The Royal Theatre 24 March 1844. Originally Hartmann had asked his close friend, Hans Christian Andersen, to write the text for the cantata which was to be performed at the mourning ceremony in Studenterforeningen (The Students' Society). However, they preferred Henrik Hertz as he until then had not had the opportunity to express his feelings on the occasion of Thorvaldsen's death, whereas Andersen already had written the song for the funeral.

incipText.p: Der drog et Bud igjennem Landet
Saa fattig var ei nogen Vraa og Ingen saa forladt
Som fra en Menighed i een og samme Kirke
En mægtig Aand thi Magten blev ham givet
Nu er den store Mester død

physDesc.physMedium: In full purple (faded) cardboard binding. Handwritten label pasted on front cover inscribed: "197 / Cantate / til / Studenterforeningens Sörgefest / for / Thorvaldsen / af / J.P.E. Hartmann / op 41.". In upper left-hand corner printed label inscribed: "Musikforeningens Archiv. / Partitur. / A. No. 169:" Cancelled. Written in brown ink. Paper: 16 staves. Hartmann has paginated each no. separately on each bifolio. Later sporadic pagination in pencil. At the end of the music on p. 38 signed and end-dated: "I:P:E: Hartmann / d: 23 Mai 1844." Two last pages blank.
